  • hotspot — list from post_hotspots for the post.

issues.display_title: Issue #424: Top 3 contributors via top_rank (replace top_contributor)
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 15/06/26

Implementation Complete - Ready for Unit Testing

Implementation:

Summary

Change the Place Detail Contributors endpoint to surface the top 3 contributors (instead of only the top 1), with a clear differentiator for rank 1 / 2 / 3. Blocked, banned, and deactivated users must be skipped, so the top 3 set can differ per requesting user.

  • Route: GET /places/detail/contributors/:location_group_slug
  • Action: src/Action/V1/Places/PlaceDetailContributors.go
  • Design doc: docs/plans/2026-06-15-place-detail-top3-contributors-design.md

Scope of Changes

Model - src/Models/PlacesModel.go

  • In PlaceDetailContributorResponse, replace TopContributor bool \json:"top_contributor"`withTopRank int `json:"top_rank"`` (1/2/3 = top contributors, 0 = others).

Action - src/Action/V1/Places/PlaceDetailContributors.go

  • Add an index to the shaping loop and compute the rank from the position after filtering: topRank = offset + i + 1 when <= 3, else 0. Stop using rc.ContributorRank == 1.
  • Default path: set TopRank: topRank.
  • include path: replace the fieldMap["top_contributor"] block with fieldMap["top_rank"] -> item["top_rank"] = topRank. The key top_contributor is no longer recognized.

Not changed

  • The views_place_detail_contributors view stays as-is (block filtering is per-user and must remain at the API layer).
  • No DB migration. Pagination, total count, following status, and response encryption are unchanged.

Why position-based ranking

contributor_rank is computed globally in the view, before the per-user block/deactivate filter is applied at the API. If the view's rank-1 is blocked by the requester, no row would have contributor_rank == 1. Using offset + i + 1 over the already-filtered, already-ordered result guarantees there is always a top 1/2/3 among the eligible users.

Breaking change

The top_contributor (bool) field is removed and replaced by top_rank (int). Clients reading top_contributor or sending ?include=top_contributor must be updated. (Client communication is tracked separately.)

Testing Scenario (for QA)

  1. Default response, page 1 - GET /places/detail/contributors/:slug. Expect the first 3 rows to have top_rank = 1, 2, 3 ordered by total_views DESC then total_posts DESC; all other rows top_rank = 0.
  2. Blocked top contributor - block the user who is rank-1 in the view, then request as that blocking user. Expect the blocked user to disappear and the next eligible user to become top_rank = 1 (no gap, never empty).

Summary

Add include parameter support to the Detail Post API.

  • Endpoint: GET /v1/posts/detail
  • File: src/Action/V1/Posts/DetailPost.go

Whitelisted fields (Published): category_id, created_at, description, slug, animation, animation_filter, little_planet, little_planet_filter, location_post, location_name, panorama_preview, thumbnail, panorama, post_type, panorama_quality, pending, avatar, fullname, encrypt, username, potd, broadcast_data, visibility, affiliate, hotspot

Whitelisted fields (Draft/Processing): slug, thumbnail, post_type, created_at, is_processing, description, location_post, location_name, avatar, fullname, encrypt, username, visibility

Logic: encrypt and visibility are always fetched internally to perform access-control checks, even if not requested in include.

?? Testing Scenario (for tester)

  • No include: default field set returned (backward compatible).
  • Published subset: include=slug,thumbnail ? only those returned.
  • Access control intact: request a post WITHOUT encrypt/visibility in include ? access control still enforced (private/hidden posts blocked).
  • Draft vs published: verify the correct whitelist applies for a processing/draft post vs a published one.
  • id excluded: include=id,slug ? id not in response.
  • Invalid field: ignored gracefully.

Source: docs/brainstorm/CHANGELOG_INCLUDE_PARAM.md ? Priority: High ? Depends on GetValidIncludes utility.

QA Review - 13 August 2026 (Dev)

Verdict: PASSED

The published Detail Post include behavior was verified using an existing public Dev post and two supplied Dev tester accounts. No persistent data was created or changed. No HTTP 500 response occurred.

Published subset Black-box, real Dev API Passed include=slug,thumbnail returned exactly slug and thumbnail.

Invalid field handling Black-box, real Dev API Passed include=password,slug ignored the invalid field and returned slug.
Whitespace and duplicate behavior Black-box, real Dev API Passed Whitespace-wrapped fields were returned correctly; duplicate request exposed one JSON slug property.
SQL-like input Black-box, real Dev API Passed Unallowed SQL-like field text was ignored; no injected field appeared.
Authentication Black-box, real Dev API Passed Request without a token returned HTTP 401.
Encryption parity Gray-box, real Dev API Passed Encrypted subset response decoded to the same filtered field set.
Second tester account Black-box, real Dev API Passed The published subset returned the expected field set.
Published access-control path White-box code review Passed encrypt, visibility, and slug are fetched internally when needed before private-visibility checks; response projection remains filtered.
Draft/processing path White-box code review Passed A separate owner-scoped query and draft allow-list are present. No owned draft was mutated or manufactured solely for QA.
